panels.caption: FIG. 1. (a) and (b) are RHEED patterns of a 7 nm BTO film on four-unitcell STO-buffered Si(001) as-deposited and after 5 min vacuum anneal at 600 /C14 C, respectively. Both images are taken along h 110 i direction of STO. (c) Si 2 p XP spectra of a typical four-unit-cell STO-buffered Si(001) film (red), a 3 nm ALD BTO film on four-unit-cell STO-buffered Si(001) asdeposited (blue), and the 3 nm BTO film after a 5 min vacuum anneal at 600 /C14 C (green). Note there is a negligible change in Si-O bonding before and after vacuum annealing and the blue and green lines are almost identical.
